title: Distant Realm
description:
Not Remaster, Reboot!
Distant Realm is originally an adventure game from 2006, combined with role-playing elements. Take control of a young man who has lost his memory upon crashing to a foreign world. Explore the island, clear dungeons, find loot, buy a farm and grow tomatoes. Your call.Features:• Overhaul of backgrounds, while keeping the feel of the authentic look

• New Dungeons & New Enemies!

• Hero movement and animation is now realistic

• Replacing arrow controls with the modern WASD scheme

• Introduction of hotkeys to make selections easier

• Improved HUD and all the text

• Improved dialogue with slightly better humor
description_short: Distant Realm is originally an adventure game from 2006, combined with role-playing elements. Now the experience is masterfully redefined.
